name: ebay-etsy-shopper
description: Lets Claude search and read eBay UK and Etsy UK in a Chrome window on your computer. No API keys.
long_description: When you ask Claude about something on eBay or Etsy, it opens the pages in Google Chrome (or Microsoft Edge) on your own computer, reads the listings and answers: comparisons, sold prices, postage, seller feedback, returns. Because it uses your own browser and internet connection, eBay and Etsy treat it like you browsing. It is read-only: it never buys, bids or messages anyone. If a site asks you to confirm you're human, complete it in the window that opened and ask again.

tools.name: ebay_search
tools.description: Search eBay UK, including sold prices

tools.name: open_page
tools.description: Read an eBay or Etsy listing, shop or search page

hide_browser.title: Hide the browser window
hide_browser.description: Run Chrome invisibly. Leave this off if eBay or Etsy ask you to confirm you're human, because you need the window to do that.
